failure.name: ALLOCATOR_UNDER_COMMITMENT
failure.description: visible actionable target exists AND a free combat USV exists AND the target has zero owner, but the allocator does not commit

root_cause.name: CONSERVATIVE_COMMITMENT
root_cause.description: default StrategicIntent focus_level=2 + reserve_ratio=0.20 keeps free USVs idle even when zero-owner visible threats exist

mechanism.name: CONDITIONAL_RESERVE_RELEASE
mechanism.summary: release the static reserve (reserve_usvs->0) only while a visible actionable zero-owner ship coexists with a free combat USV; otherwise keep W5 reserve semantics
mechanism.trigger_condition: visible ship with zero owners AND a free combat USV (usv_map owner None, alive, positioned)
mechanism.behavior_change: allocator breadth: more zero-owner targets get committed; reserve preserved when no under-commitment

validation.fresh_status: UNCONFIRMED (Fresh run invalid: API process accidentally killed; 54/60 connection refused)

limitations: Fresh confirmatory round invalid -> not promoted
S1 shows a knife-edge (0/20 vs 20/7 across seeds) so gains partly timing-sensitive
ACE shares W5's USVController; it does not change lock/engagement geometry
lessons: expanding allocator breadth (0->1 owner) raises assignment coverage and kills without touching detection/controller
single-seed improvements can be timing noise; require paired fresh seeds
next_questions: after broader commitment, which transition fails next: lock acquisition, kill closure, or survival?
